items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: a fellow by the name of Shuffle Abernathy. So, out in that part of the country people don't ... venture there out that way. When a musician pass through, they want you in there if you can make it. It's tremendous. He had a little band out there.
